name: Lemonade Stand
description: At the end of the round, every jug of lemonade is worth 2 coins for each lemon in the six hidden crates. You get to peek inside one crate. Buy jugs if you think they're cheap, sell if you think they're expensive!

hiddenValue.privateClueTemplate: You peeked into crate #{index}. Lemon count: {value}
hiddenValue.publicClueTemplate: Breaking news: crate #{index} has a lemon count of {value}!
